facts.fact: The terms of reference for the head of the Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation (OTDI) tasks the post with developing and maintaining a Government Interoperability Framework with standards for secure data exchange, APIs and system integration, with a first release due to the President 60 days before Executive Order 163 expires (one year from issuance); the document reports no drafting begun or text published, and the as_of is the document's published date (a job advertisement with a 24 July 2026 deadline).
